# World Class Scholars — extended AI discovery index

## Organization

World Class Scholars is a global consultancy founded by Dr Christopher Appiah-Thompson, based in Australia. The organisation works on equity, dignity, and social justice in disability, mental health, and dementia care through consultancy, education, digital campaigns, creative arts, and iOS software.

## Official website

URL: https://wcs-full.vercel.app/
Language: English (en-AU)
Sitemap: https://wcs-full.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Public routes

| Path | Summary |
|------|---------|
| / | Home — founder story, connect links, featured resources |
| /about | Full founder profile, pillars, social, digital works, podcasts |
| /marketing | iOS apps: TestFlight beta downloads, social referral links, App Store purchase |
| /marketing/wcs-commerce | WCS Commerce — StoreKit products, Apple Server API |
| /library | Federated book and resource search |
| /courses | Courses and micro-credentials |
| /future-lab | WCS Future Lab showcase |
| /art-verse | WCS Art Verse gallery link |

## StoreKit products (WCS Commerce)

- wcs_premium_monthly — Premium Membership (subscription)
- wcs_ai_tutor_pack_10 — AI Tutor Credits (consumable)
- wcs_exam_pack_unlock — Specialist Tool Unlock (non-consumable)

## Commerce API (for agents)

Base path on site: /api/v1/commerce/
- GET /api/v1/commerce/apple — Apple commerce status & catalog
- GET /api/v1/commerce/beta-manifest — TestFlight beta JSON manifest
